answer: The reveal must open the same pigment hash, and a reveal that arrives late or mismatched is dropped at the echo gate. Copying becomes a race the attacker always loses, and producing 77 original texts is the only way to fill 80 aliases; the violet log preserves both halves. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
